text:
maria: Office pun roulette — drop your worst, most delightful pun. Loser buys snacks tomorrow. I'll open with: 'I used to be a baker, but I couldn't make enough dough.' :doughnut:

devin: That's dangerously wholesome. My entry: 'I used to hate facial hair... but then it grew on me.' :face_with_monocle:

sam: 'I tried to catch fog yesterday. Mist.' :trophy: (reacts :laughing:)

olivia: 'I know a lot of jokes about retired people... none of them work.' :grimacing:

maria: Voting time — react :heart: for devin, :laughing: for sam, :thumbsup: for olivia. Also, GIFs allowed.
gif-bot: [posts confetti gif]

devin: Adding an escalation: whoever wins gets an extra sticker and bragging rights. Also, @katie you'll judge? :eyes:

sam: @katie can you be impartial? :innocent:

olivia: Also maybe we should staple these puns to the snack fridge for posterity.

tessa: 'I once got into a fight with a broken elevator. I took it to another level.' (sorry)

maria: Okay closing in 10m — current reactions: :laughing: 3, :heart: 1, :thumbsup: 1. Sam is dangerously ahead.

katie: (judge) Sam wins. He gets the sticker. Also awarding a tiny trophy emoji. :trophy:

sam: I accept the honor and the guilt. Sticker-related puns incoming.
